name: SDN Host FlatSQL Query Node
description: Host FlatSQL query connector (typed contracts 1.0). No JSON between modules and no base64. Method "query" is the FlatSQL node's query_records contract (flatsql cpp/src/sdn_node.cpp) served over the host bridge: ONE $FSO control frame (OPERATION QUERY_RECORDS, QUERY = SQL bytes, PARAMETERS in FlatSQL's tagged encoding [u8 tag][u32le size][bytes], PARAMETER_COUNT, REQUEST_ID) becomes ONE storage.flatsql_query_stream hostcall (SDS $PIV: SqlStreamParams DELIVER Inline, raw sql, list sql_params SqlValue) and answers $FSB QUERY_RESULT chunks on "records" (DATA <= 1 MiB each, CHUNK_SEQUENCE from 0, FINAL on the last, at least one chunk) plus ONE $FSO on "status" (COMPLETE with AFFECTED_RECORDS = rows and RESULT_BYTES, or INVALID_ARGUMENT / RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / INTERNAL_ERROR with ERROR_CODE and MESSAGE; a database-semantics failure answers on status alone, invoke status 0, as the FlatSQL node does). A parameter the bridge's SqlValue record cannot carry (bytes; a string over 255 bytes) is refused (unsupported-parameter), never truncated. Method "sandbox_query" serves the PUBLIC /api/v1/query surface: a QRP Request on "query" (SQL + PARAMETERS, SORT_FIELD/SORT_DESC and LIMIT composed here into the effective SQL, or a TIME_PROFILE over the unified OMM view: Nearest/AsOf/Forward per object with PROFILE_EPOCH_MS (0 = clock.now) and SOURCE_NAME, or All = every record of the source in the FROM_EPOCH_MS / TO_EPOCH_MS window; Unspecified = no profile, SQL required; a window with SQL or a per-object profile is refused 400 window-unsupported) goes to the READ-ONLY storage.query_sandboxed hostcall (the engine enforces the sandbox in-wasm: authorizer, single-statement SELECT, timeout, row/byte caps); a QRP Request on "surface" goes to storage.query_surface. It answers the request verbatim on "decision" plus ONE QRP-headed size-prefixed stream on "page" (a Page header - FILE_IDENTIFIER, SCHEMA_NAME, RECORD_COUNT, ETAG W/"fnv1a64-..." over the records - then the record frames verbatim; or a projection page with COLUMNS + ROWS; or the surface page with TABLES + MAX_ELAPSED_MS/MAX_ROWS/MAX_BYTES), or a QRP Error on "decision" with HTTP_STATUS set (missing-sql, ambiguous-query, invalid-profile, invalid-sort, window-unsupported, unsupported-parameter, query-failed 400; not-acceptable 406; timeout / too-large 422; host-failed 502). Pages carry HTTP_STATUS 200. Delivery: a non-Json request asks DELIVER Ref; a host BodyRef answer makes the page the header ALONE with BODY_REF_TOKEN / BODY_REF_SIZE (RECORD_COUNT = the host's frame count, ETAG W/"fnv1a64-<host hash>"), resolved by the egress; a host that ignores Ref, and every Json request, gets the bytes inline. Host support: storage.* is served by the Go node (capability storage_query); the SDK JS hosts have no typed adapter for these ops yet.

externalInterfaces.description: Host FlatSQL engine queries as SDS $PIV hostcalls: storage.flatsql_query_stream (operator surface, unsandboxed, auth-gated at the wall), storage.query_sandboxed and storage.query_surface (the public read-only surface).
clock.now defaults a profile query's epoch to now (Go node built-in; capability-gated on the SDK hosts).

acceptedTypeSets.description: $FSO (SDS FSO): OPERATION QUERY_RECORDS, QUERY = UTF-8 SQL bytes, PARAMETERS = FlatSQL tagged parameters (tags 0 null, 1 bool, 2 int64, 3 float64, 4 string, 5 bytes), PARAMETER_COUNT, REQUEST_ID (echoed).

inputPorts.description: ONE FlatSQL control frame per invocation.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $FSB (SDS FSB): KIND QUERY_RESULT, DATA = the aligned size-prefixed result stream in chunks of at most 1 MiB, CHUNK_SEQUENCE from 0, FINAL on the last, TOTAL_BYTES, RECORD_COUNT = rows, COLUMN_COUNT.

outputPorts.description: The query result as ordered $FSB chunks (at least one).

acceptedTypeSets.description: $FSO (SDS FSO): OPERATION QUERY_RECORDS, REQUEST_ID, STATUS COMPLETE (AFFECTED_RECORDS rows, RESULT_BYTES) or INVALID_ARGUMENT / RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / INTERNAL_ERROR with ERROR_CODE (invalid-control-frame, unsupported-parameter, query-failed) and MESSAGE.

outputPorts.description: Exactly one status frame per invocation.

methods.description: Executes one FlatSQL query through the storage.flatsql_query_stream hostcall (typed: SDS $PIV) and answers the result as $FSB chunks plus one $FSO status - the FlatSQL node's query_records contract. BATCHING: every input port here is single-stream BY CONTRACT and ENFORCED IN CODE: maxStreams/maxBatch/drainPolicy are purely DECLARATIVE in the compiled flow runtime (space_data_module_runtime_begin_node_invocation pops the node's whole queue port-blind up to the drain budget of 64), so a surplus frame on a port is refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count, rather than silently destroyed (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames). Port-filtered access only.

acceptedTypeSets.description: QRP KIND Request: SQL + PARAMETERS (QRPValue Null/Bool/Int/Float/Text), SORT_FIELD + SORT_DESC, LIMIT (TIME_PROFILE Unspecified); or TIME_PROFILE Nearest/AsOf/Forward with PROFILE_EPOCH_MS (0 = now) and SOURCE_NAME; or TIME_PROFILE All with SOURCE_NAME and an optional FROM_EPOCH_MS / TO_EPOCH_MS window; REPRESENTATION; ETAG (= If-None-Match).

inputPorts.description: A public query (exactly one of query / surface carries a frame).

acceptedTypeSets.description: QRP KIND Request with REPRESENTATION and ETAG only.

inputPorts.description: A request for the queryable-surface listing (exactly one of query / surface carries a frame).

acceptedTypeSets.description: The QRP request verbatim when served, else a QRP Error (ERROR_CODE, MESSAGE, HTTP_STATUS, REPRESENTATION and ETAG carried over).

outputPorts.description: Exactly one decision per invocation, for foundation/http-respond respond_query.

acceptedTypeSets.description: ONE size-prefixed stream: the QRP Page header (FinishSizePrefixed, padded to 8 bytes with a zero-length prefix) followed by the record frames verbatim (FILE_IDENTIFIER from the first frame, RECORD_COUNT, ETAG W/"fnv1a64-<16 hex>" over the records); a projection page (COLUMNS + ROWS, TOTAL_COUNT); or the surface page (TABLES + MAX_ELAPSED_MS / MAX_ROWS / MAX_BYTES). Header-only pages carry an ETAG over the header built without one. Every page carries HTTP_STATUS 200. With a host body reference the page is the header alone carrying BODY_REF_TOKEN / BODY_REF_SIZE.

methods.description: Executes one sandboxed public query (storage.query_sandboxed; WANT Stream for FlatBuffer/Default, Auto for Json; DELIVER Ref for FlatBuffer/Default, Inline for Json) or lists the queryable surface (storage.query_surface), composing profile SQL and sort/limit in-wasm. BATCHING: every input port here is single-stream BY CONTRACT and ENFORCED IN CODE: maxStreams/maxBatch/drainPolicy are purely DECLARATIVE in the compiled flow runtime (space_data_module_runtime_begin_node_invocation pops the node's whole queue port-blind up to the drain budget of 64), so a surplus frame on a port is refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count, rather than silently destroyed (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames). Port-filtered access only.
